profile.headline: Full-Stack Web Developer
profile.summary: Before I began my journey into web development, I’d been steeped in the entertainment industry all my life. My father and brothers are all in the music business. I went a slightly different direction into film school, but as soon as I had the chance to make the soundtrack to my first feature I became so engrossed with the result that once the film was distributed I took a detour into songwriting and spent the next several years recording and licensing songs to companies such as Garnier, Vicks, Citibank, American Idol, and many others. I formed and fronted a band of all-star Nashville session musicians that brought an intense live show of 60’s rock & soul to modern audiences at clubs, weddings, and private events. I worked for several years at Cityhouse, one of Nashville’s best restaurants, where I went from hosting to assistant manager. In 2021 I took a full-time 2-year screenwriting contract with the independent film director/producer, Billy Senese. As that contract came to a close, I knew I wanted to dive into a viable skill that would push me in new ways, while taking advantage of my appetite for creative problem solving. Tech has proven a perfect fit and the world of coding continues to open my mind daily in ways I couldn't have imagined.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Intensive six-month web development bootcamp with self-driven lab-based learning for HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Python, and SQL.

• Fully immersive hands on learning environment
• Team-based developmental focus
• Applied skills for the interpretation of existing code
• Git and GitHub fluency

PROJECTS:

CHATTY BOT
• Worked with a team of 4 to create an AI chatbot application using Python
• Played a lead role in project management and reaching MVP
• Utilized external API
• Coordinated with the group to use GitHub at all stages for seamless workflow

BIBLIOMANIAC
• Individual project using React to create an application that organizes a personal reading library, and gives the user suggestions as to what they should read next based on set parameters
• Full CRD functionality
• Utilized CSS and Flexbox for clean user interface

positions.title: Screenwriter
positions.description:
• Collaborated with other filmmakers and writers to develop original screenplays and television series 
• Conceptualized the original ideas and wrote numerous drafts, coordinated with my co-writers
• Final drafts were completed to meet set deadlines for entrance to the marketplace

positions.insights: Microsoft Excel, Conflict Resolution and +3 skills

positions.description:
• Managed reservations for fine dining restaurant
• Paired guests with their server and handled any problems with front-of-house service
• Maintained steady workflow throughout the dining room
• Trained all new employees in the basics of front-of-house services

positions.title: Songwriter
positions.description:
• Collaborated with various artists to write and perform original songs 
• Created original content to meet deadlines
• Licensed original songs to clients for commercial use

projects.title: Chatty Bot
projects.description: A fully functional AI chatbot using exterior API and capable of in depth conversation with the user.

projects.title: Bibliomaniac
projects.description: An application designed to organize the user's personal library of books, and through several chosen parameters, determine and display a list of what the user should read next.
